featured_reviews.name: Vipul J Meher
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience at this shop was very disappointing. I bought a pair of JoyBean brand sandals for ₹1,500. The shopkeeper initially quoted ₹1,900, and after bargaining, I purchased them for ₹1,500. However, when I returned home and checked the brand’s official website, I found that the MRP was ₹1,399 and the selling price was ₹1,245. Moreover, the original price tag had been removed from the item.

It appears that inflating the price first and then reducing it during bargaining is a tactic used to make customers feel satisfied, while still giving the shopkeeper an unfair advantage.

This practice is misleading and unfair. I advise others to avoid such fraudulent shops. If you do visit, make sure to check the price tag and do not fall for the shopkeeper’s sweet talk.

description:
Onitsuka Tiger is a Japanese sports fashion brand started in 1949 by Onitsuka Shōkai (鬼塚商会, Onitsuka Co., Ltd), a sports shoes company founded by Kihachiro Onitsuka. Onitsuka Shōkai changed its name to Onitsuka Co., Ltd. before becoming Asics Corporation in 1977. Since 1977, Onitsuka Tiger has been sold as a lifestyle brand of Asics

Shoes for Kids, Men and Women

owner_posts.post_text:
Onitsuka Tiger TRASPIKE – Black/Black

Sleek, lightweight, and effortlessly versatile, the TRASPIKE in Black/Black blends sporty design with modern everyday style. Its streamlined silhouette, premium materials, and all-black finish create a refined look that transitions seamlessly from casual outings to elevated streetwear.

- Premium suede and textile upper for a clean, sophisticated finish
- Monochrome Black/Black colourway for versatile everyday styling
- Lightweight FLYTEFOAM™ cushioning for all-day comfort
- Signature Onitsuka Tiger Stripes with refined stitched detailing
- Slim outsole inspired by track footwear for flexibility and stability
- Includes an extra pair of laces for personalised styling

Perfect for those who appreciate understated style, the Black/Black colourway pairs effortlessly with jeans, tailored trousers, or relaxed everyday fits. Its minimalist design makes it an easy choice for any occasion while delivering exceptional comfort throughout the day.

Available in-store now – discover the perfect combination of modern style, lightweight comfort, and everyday versatility.

Onitsuka Tiger MEXICO 66 TGRS – Ivory/Cream

A delicate expression of elegance and comfort, the MEXICO 66 TGRS in Ivory/Cream redefines everyday footwear with its graceful silhouette and soft neutral palette. Inspired by the timeless charm of ballet flats and the heritage of the iconic MEXICO 66, this design delivers a refined aesthetic that feels effortlessly sophisticated.

- Smooth ivory-toned upper creates a clean and versatile look
- Dual buckle straps add a feminine touch while ensuring a secure fit
- Scalloped detailing enhances the shoe's elegant and distinctive character
- Lightweight construction provides lasting comfort for daily wear
- Slim rubber outsole offers flexibility and a streamlined profile

Designed for those who appreciate understated luxury, the Ivory/Cream colourway pairs beautifully with everything from flowing dresses to tailored separates. Its soft monochromatic finish creates a polished appearance that transitions seamlessly from daytime outings to evening occasions.

Available in-store now – embrace timeless elegance with a silhouette that combines graceful styling, everyday comfort, and iconic Onitsuka Tiger heritage.

Onitsuka Tiger MEXICO 66 TGRS – Silver/Cream

A dazzling blend of elegance and everyday wearability, the MEXICO 66 TGRS in Silver/Cream reimagines a classic silhouette with a graceful, fashion-forward twist. The radiant metallic silver finish is softened by delicate cream accents and charming buckle straps, creating a design that feels both sophisticated and effortlessly unique.

- Metallic silver upper delivers a luminous, eye-catching finish
- Dual adjustable straps add a refined touch while ensuring a secure fit
- Cream detailing creates a soft contrast that enhances the premium aesthetic
- Lightweight construction offers lasting comfort for daily wear
- Slim-profile outsole preserves the sleek character of the MEXICO 66 heritage

Crafted for those who love footwear that stands out with elegance rather than excess, this colourway effortlessly bridges the gap between classic sneakers and contemporary fashion. The Silver/Cream combination brings a polished, elevated feel that pairs beautifully with everything from casual denim to chic everyday outfits.

Available in-store now – shine with confidence in a silhouette that blends timeless heritage, feminine charm, and modern sophistication.

I have been a regular customer and have always appreciated how warm, professional, and courteous your earlier team was. Unfortunately, my recent experience was completely different and quite disappointing.

On 19th January 2026, I visited your store to purchase a pair of shoes. The attitude of one of the sales staff members (a lady) was extremely unprofessional and unpleasant. What made this even more upsetting was that it was my birthday, and I had come to the store in a happy mood, expecting a pleasant shopping experience. Sadly, this incident completely ruined that moment for me.

featured_reviews.name: Dipti
featured_reviews.review_text:
*Avoid This Footwear Shop – Unethical Reward Scheme**

I strongly **condemn** the deceptive practices of this footwear store regarding their rewards point scheme. They are **misleading customers** and manipulating redemption rules to suit their convenience.

Every time I attempted to **redeem my points**, they changed the **minimum requirement** or imposed new restrictions, ensuring I could never actually benefit from the scheme. Across **three consecutive purchases**, they **fooled me** with false assurances, only to deny redemption again at checkout.

When confronted about this **unethical practice**, their excuse was, *"It's the system."* If that’s the case, why don’t they **notify customers** about point expiry dates? When I questioned them about this, they had the audacity to say they don’t want to *“disturb customers by sending SMS reminders.”*

This is outright **fraud**—a deliberate attempt to **loot customers** by offering fake rewards that are nearly impossible to redeem. I highly **advise against purchasing** from this shop if you value transparency and fairness in your transactions
